card.name: Linking words before treatment terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, of, to, were, between, after) in experimental or toxicology text where the next word is likely 'treated', 'treatment' or 'drug-treated'. It appears in comparisons of treated and control groups.

modes.label: Comparing treated vs control
modes.description: Linking word in a comparison between control and drug-treated groups.
modes.example: no other difference was noted<< between>> the controls and drug-treated groups.

modes.label: Dosing in animal studies
modes.description: Linking word or verb just before a mention of animals being treated or dosed.
modes.example: When pregnant rabbits<< were>> treated during organogenesis

modes.label: Lab experiment setup
modes.description: Word in a lab question or test description where a treatment or exposure comes next.
modes.example: in the absence<< of>> metabolic activation.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict treatment, treated or treat as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small words that often come right before the word 'treated' or 'treatment' in study descriptions.
